Dhula, District Darrang, Assam - 784146, and must be received by 28 Novemb

content_sections.heading: About the School
content_sections.text: Adarsha Vidyalaya, Pub Mangaldai is an English medium government school under the CBSE curriculum, established in 2018, located at Village Ondulajhar, P.O. Dhula, District Darrang, Assam. The Guest Educators are engaged under the School Development Fund (SDF) Guidelines issued by Adarsha Vidyalaya Sangathan, Assam (No. AVS/SDF/2022/01/417 dated 24.01.2025) and the school-specific permission dated 31.08.2026, to provide temporary academic support for the academic session 2026-27.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application goes to this address: Principal, Adarsha Vidyalaya, Pub Mangaldai, Village Ondulajhar, P.O. Dhula, District Darrang, Assam - 784146. Prepare the application in Standard Form, indicating the subject applied for and your contact number. Attach the self-attested documents and the recent passport-size photograph listed under Enclosures below. Submit the application to the Principal during school office hours, from 10 AM to 3 PM. Make sure it is received by 28/11/26 at 3 PM; applications received after the deadline shall not be considered. If you are applying for more than one subject, submit a separate application for each subject. The notice does not say where the Standard Form can be obtained, and no form is attached to the notice. For enquiries, the school's letterhead gives the email [email protected] and phone number 9101115105.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All posts are Guest Educator engagements with the same honorarium rule (see below). The subject-wise requirement is: Applicants must be permanent residents of Assam; retired persons and subject experts are also invited. Minimum qualification: graduation in the relevant subject from a recognized university. For Physics, Geography and Biology, a postgraduate degree in the respective subject is required. Preference will be given to candidates possessing B.Ed./D.El.Ed. from a recognized institution. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the subject-specific eligibility of each post. Honorarium shall be payable for actual working days, up to a maximum of 20 days in a month, in accordance with prevailing AVS norms and subject to availability of SDF funds against the school. Payment shall be made by Adarsha Vidyalaya Sangathan, Assam, as authorized in its letter dated 31.08.2026. The Principal shall maintain an attendance register. Services shall be utilized locally by the Principal, purely on a temporary, voluntary and daily basis, initially for one month. The period may be extendable up to a total of three months, subject to requirement, satisfactory performance and availability of SDF funds, but shall not extend beyond the academic session 2026-27. The service shall confer no right to regular appointment, continuation or regularization. No appointment or engagement letter shall be issued, as stipulated in Clause 15 (a) of the SDF Guidelines. An experience certificate shall be provided by the Principal on completion of the voluntary service.

faq.question: Q1. How many Guest Educator vacancies are there at Adarsha Vidyalaya, Pub Mangaldai?
faq.answer: There are 10 Guest Educator positions: 2 for Assamese and 1 each for Hindi, Information Technology, Physical Education, Fine Arts, Physics, Music, Geography and Biology.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 28/11/26 at 3 PM. Applications received after the deadline shall not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: Graduation in the relevant subject from a recognized university is required; for Physics, Geography and Biology, a postgraduate degree in the respective subject is required. Preference will be given to candidates with B.Ed./D.El.Ed. from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the honorarium for Guest Educators?
faq.answer: Honorarium is payable for actual working days, up to a maximum of 20 days in a month, in accordance with prevailing AVS norms and subject to availability of SDF funds. Payment is made by Adarsha Vidyalaya Sangathan, Assam.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the application in Standard Form, stating the subject and your contact number, with self-attested documents and a photograph, to the Principal, Adarsha Vidyalaya, Pub Mangaldai, Village Ondulajhar, P.O. Dhula, District Darrang, Assam - 784146, between 10 AM and 3 PM.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is based on scrutiny of applications, a personal interview and a classroom demonstration before a Selection Committee. The interview date, time and venue will be displayed on the school notice board.

faq.question: Q7. Who can apply?
faq.answer: Eligible permanent residents of Assam can apply, including retired persons and subject experts.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Guest Educator job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The service is temporary, voluntary and on a daily basis, initially for one month, and may be extended up to a total of three months but not beyond the academic session 2026-27. It confers no right to regular appointment, continuation or regularization.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one subject?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates applying for more than one subject must submit a separate application for each subject.

faq.question: Q10. Will an appointment letter be issued?
faq.answer: No appointment or engagement letter will be issued, as stipulated in Clause 15 (a) of the SDF Guidelines. The Principal will provide an experience certificate on completion of the voluntary service.
